doc: A Venus-like retrograde slow rotator (-243 d): no storm track (raw edge >> 50), zonal_wind_scale = 0, the profile is 0 (times spin -1: negative zeros), not the real super-rotation the model does not describe. 181 float64 latitudes -90..90 every degree. Float64 closed form (gaussians, a smoothstep, a scale): rtol 1e-9. Arguments: lat (input, rad), hadley_deg and body (params). Measured: one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 0 (worst of 6 random trials); no difference was observed at all.
